intro.lead: Build research experience at the intersection of exercise physiology, neuroscience, behavior, electrophysiology, and open science.
intro.description: LaFiSE welcomes prospective students and collaborators who want to develop rigorous, reproducible research with animal models. Explore the routes below and contact us before applying so we can discuss research fit, supervision, and current availability.

sections.title: PhD pathways
sections.description: Doctoral researchers may connect with LaFiSE through either of two UFRN graduate programs, depending on the emphasis of the proposed project.

cards.title: Psychobiology
cards.description: For projects centered on behavior and its biological bases, including learning and memory, sleep, exercise, and systems neuroscience.

cards.title: Physiological Sciences
cards.description: For projects focused on physiological mechanisms, including exercise physiology, neurophysiology, and integrated experimental approaches.

sections.title: Master's pathways
sections.description: Master's projects combine focused research questions with hands-on training in experimental design, data collection, analysis, and scientific communication.

cards.label: Psychobiology
cards.title: Behavior and brain
cards.description: Develop a project linking exercise, behavior, cognition, sleep, or neural activity through the Graduate Program in Psychobiology.

cards.label: Physiological Sciences
cards.title: Mechanisms and function
cards.description: Investigate exercise and physiological function through the Multicenter Graduate Program in Physiological Sciences.

sections.title: Undergraduate research
sections.description: Undergraduate students can take their first steps in research while contributing to active laboratory projects.

cards.label: Scientific initiation
cards.title: Join an active project
cards.description: Learn how a research question becomes an experiment and gain supervised experience in literature review, laboratory routines, data organization, and analysis.

cards.label: Research training
cards.title: Build practical skills
cards.description: Develop a foundation in reproducible workflows, scientific programming, behavioral methods, electrophysiology, and research communication according to project needs.

sections.title: Equipment and research tools
sections.description: Researchers and partner groups may contact LaFiSE to discuss collaborative access, technical feasibility, training requirements, and scheduling.

cards.title: Multimodal treadmill
cards.description: A research platform for controlled locomotion and behavioral paradigms, designed to support multimodal experimental protocols.

cards.title: Electrophysiology workflows
cards.description: Collaborative support for neural-signal experiments, from study planning and acquisition workflows to quality control and analysis.

cards.title: Software and analysis
cards.description: Open and reproducible tools for behavioral data, electrophysiological signals, artifact rejection, visualization, and research workflows.

contact.title: Tell us how you would like to work with LaFiSE.
contact.description: Introduce yourself, your background, the opportunity you are interested in, and the research question or resource you would like to explore.
